thinkingmachines/inkling:free: API error 403 (model not available on this harness)
learnings: Models with smaller context windows (262k) cannot audit large minified JS bundles (300k+ tokens). The tool should route large files to models with larger context or use chunked analysis.
Router-based models (openrouter/free) may fail to select files for review when the prompt format is ambiguous. The file selection prompt should be more explicit about required files.

For prebuilt binary packages, the audit should clearly distinguish between 'packaging code' (PKGBUILD, .install) and 'upstream payload' (the actual application). The payload is not subject to AUR maintainer injection if checksums are pinned.
API errors (403, 429) should be treated as coverage gaps, not verdict signals. The tool should retry or route to alternative models.
